title: Marc was amazing and made the tour so fun!
text: Marc was an amazing tour guide! We visited from the US and he was very insightful, funny and kept the good energy going. I know people are sometimes iffy about guided tours but it was really helpful to actually know what I’m looking at and knowing the cool history, instead of doing self guided. Would highly recommend!
author: Brittany_W

title: Nice tour, but make sure you know where the meeting point is.
text: Even the tour guide Gemma was very nice and professional, we did not fully enjoy the tour because of waste the energy finding meeting place. It was not clear that we will not be able to enter the park using other gates. We spent 45 minutes running up and down to finally got to the meeting point.
author: Elina_C

title: Plan on walking and every...
text: Plan on walking and every step is worth it. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone in Barcelona
author: Sherilynn_V

title: Enjoy the Park!

title: Nice tour.  Guide was...
text: Nice tour.  Guide was excellent and easily understandable.  Many interesting historical facts about the park, the Guells and Gaudi were provided.  Park is beautiful and Gaudi design is very interesting.  Very heavy crowds (on a Sunday in October).
author: Richard_B

title: Well worth the Tour+
text: Marc was great! He had a fun sense if humour and shared so much information. He was very friendly and approachable. Easy to find him at the beginning of tour. 5+*'s
author: Alynne_A

title: Park Guell
text: The park was beautiful and Mark was an excellent tour guide.  Very informative and friendly!  Would definitely recommend!

title: A wonderful experience
text: Marc was a wonderful guide.  Very informative with a lovely touch of humor thrown in.  It was a delightful afternoon at an amazing location.
